facts.value: The British burned Washington in 1814 and destroyed the small congressional library. Congress then bought Thomas Jefferson's personal library of 6,487 books to start again.
facts.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://www.loc.gov/about/history-of-the-library/' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -o -m1 -F 'comprehensive personal library of 6,487 books'

facts.value: During the Second World War the Library helped plan the shipment of the Declaration of Independence and the Constitution to Fort Knox, Kentucky, for safekeeping.
facts.quote: along with other treasures, to Fort Knox, Kentucky

facts.value: The Library's Gutenberg Bible, bought in 1930, is one of three perfect copies on vellum in the world, the Library says.
